title: pv.duplicate_check
description: Structured duplicate-suspicion evaluation for a PV case. Per DDD domain_model.md §7, this must complete before SignalTriaged can fire — enforced as a graph edge (langgraph_design.md §7), not by this tool refusing to be called out of order, since the tool has no way to observe graph state. Provisional: designed by analogy to batch.reconcile, not yet built (20b scope, tool_inventory.md §3).
authorization_requirement: Caller must present a pv_intake graph-run credential.

idempotency.guarantee: Idempotent for a fixed comparison_window_version; NOT idempotent across window versions, since new cases can arrive.

case_summary_evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids from this run's evidence.retrieve (pv scope) call describing the incoming case.

comparison_window_version.description: Version stamp of the case set this comparison ran against. A cached result is invalid once this version advances — see prohibited_write_enforcement.md and tool_inventory.md §6 caching note for pv.duplicate_check.

candidates.description: Candidate matching cases with a structural similarity score. Ranking within this set is the PV-Intake Agent's job (agent_roster.md §2); this tool does not rank or conclude.

what_this_schema_cannot_express: This tool has no field that constitutes a duplicate determination as a final safety conclusion. 'duplicate_suspected' is a triage signal only — DDD domain_model.md §10 requires the PV-Intake Agent to escalate any output touching causality/seriousness/expectedness/reportability, and this tool's output has no such fields to escalate incorrectly.
open_items: Duplicate-detection threshold logic (numeric vs. rule-based) is unconfirmed against V2's actual grader code (domain_model.md §8) — must be verified before this leaves provisional status, per the ADR-002 standing rule (never claim V2 behaviour without reading V2 code).
